items.t: CVT shudder, hesitation and failure
items.note: Owners report about $4,000-$7,000. Ask about the judder bulletin and any extended CVT coverage first; a software update or fluid service is far cheaper if it helps.

items.t: Oil sludge and engine failure
items.note: Owners were quoted about $14,000-$16,000 at dealers. A used engine from an independent shop costs much less.

items.t: Timing chain rattle or tapping
items.job: Replace timing chain, guides and tensioners
items.note: Diagnosis alone runs about $150-$225.

items.t: Erratic or high idle from a dirty throttle body
items.job: Clean throttle body and perform idle relearn

items.t: Catalytic converters fail early
items.note: The V6 has more than one converter; replacing both costs roughly double.

items.t: Wheel bearing hum or growl
items.job: Replace front wheel hub and bearing (one side)

items.t: Engine cooling fan stops working
Rattles or squeaks from the dashboard
items.job: Locate and secure loose dash trim
items.note: Labor varies with how much trim must come off.

items.t: Sun visor breaks or won't stay up
items.note: One owner paid about $100.

items.t: Paint defects on a new vehicle
items.note: May be covered by the paint warranty on newer vehicles.

items.t: Side mirror can come loose or fall off
items.note: Owners report about $600.

items.t: Passenger air bag may switch off with an adult seated (recall)
items.job: Update or replace occupant sensing parts (recall)
items.note: Free at any Infiniti dealer. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Hood safety catch may not hold (recall)
items.note: Free at any Infiniti dealer. Check the VIN first.

items.note: Free at any Infiniti dealer. Check the VIN first.

items.note: Free at any Infiniti dealer. Check the VIN first.

items.note: Free at any Infiniti dealer. Check the VIN first.

items.note: Free at any Infiniti dealer. Check the VIN first.

items.note: Free at any Infiniti dealer. Check the VIN first.

items.note: Free at any Infiniti dealer. Check the VIN first.

items.job: Inspect and replace steering knuckle or rear axle housing (recall)
items.note: Free at any Infiniti dealer. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Infotainment screen goes black or acts up
items.note: Usually covered by warranty on these model years. Replacing the audio-visual unit costs much more.

items.t: Sunroof rattles or glass breaks
items.note: Rattles and glass may be covered under the new-vehicle warranty; comprehensive insurance may cover broken glass.
